lines.statement_nl: Acme Ltd placed purchase order PO-4492 for twelve pallets of SKU-7781 and expects dock scheduling within forty-eight hours.
BetaCorp Industries must receive written shipment confirmation before NetLedger closes the ledger for fiscal Q2.
Acme Ltd and BetaCorp Industries both submitted bids referencing the heavy actuator line SKU-7781 on the same multi-vendor request.
Contoso Trading disputed the order_pre_tax_total on their open PurchaseOrder after freight was rebilled.
Every open PurchaseOrder must have exactly one responsible account manager drawn from the SalesEmployee roster.
Fabrikam LLC ordered forty units of catalog SKU-9910 with expedited handling.
Notwithstanding prior notices, Acme Ltd's PurchaseOrder covering SKU-7781 remains subject to BetaCorp Industries' carrier confirmation rules through period end.
Apply order_pre_tax_total to Acme Ltd's open PO that still lists line items under SKU-7781.
SKU-9910 may not ship on the same PurchaseOrder as SKU-7781 for Acme Ltd without procurement approval.
SalesEmployee approval is required before any PurchaseOrder exceeding the discretionary threshold is released.
Contoso Trading and Fabrikam LLC use different pallet rounding rules when fulfilling StockKeepingUnit picks.
BetaCorp Industries' pretax MoneyAmount on the disputed PurchaseOrder did not match the vendor credit memo.
